newsitem.title: UK: Ruhrgas deal worth $1 bln, BP says.
newsitem.headline: Ruhrgas deal worth $1 bln, BP says.

text.p: Oil group British Petroleum Plc said on Monday it signed a 15-year agreement to supply 15 billion cubic metres of gas valued at more than $1.0 billion dollars to Germany's Ruhrgas.

BP said in a statement the supply contract will start on October 1 next year. The gas will be supplied from BP's portfolio of fields and delivered via the Interconnector pipeline being constructed from Bacton in Norfolk, in east England to Zeebrugge in Belgium, BP said.
BP said onward transmission of the gas will be undertaken by Distrigaz in Belgium.

"This is a landmark gas supply deal as it represents our first sale into continental Europe from the UK and our first use of the capacity we own in the Interconnector pipeline," BP Exploration chief executive Rodney Chase said.
BP said its share of the British commercial and industrial gas market has more than doubled to 15 percent since it restructured its marketing activities in Britain in August, 1996.
It said its combined sales of gas to industry, commerce, the power sector and the spot market place it second to British Gas Plc in the British gas market.
